notes:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> PHP 8.5.13 fixed several serious security holes, including remote code execution and PHP-FPM request smuggling.

## What changed in the image

Databasify now runs on the official PHP image (Debian 13) instead of Ubuntu 26.04 packages. PHP, nginx and Redis are pinned to exact upstream versions, so new security releases reach you as soon as we publish them.

| | 0.2.3 | This release |
|---|---|---|
| PHP | 8.5.4 (Ubuntu backports) | 8.5.13 |
| nginx | 1.28.3 (Ubuntu backports) | 1.31.9 (nginx.org mainline) |
| Redis | 8.0.5 | 8.8.4 |

Your data, settings and queued jobs carry over. Redis 8.8 reads the data written by 8.0.

## Also updated

Laravel 13.43, Horizon 5.52, Reverb 1.14, Fortify 1.43, Passkeys 0.3 and vite-plus 1.7.
